messages:
maggie: Heads-up — we're planning a staged rollout of contextual help panels across the SDK docs next week. Goal: surface quick examples and error troubleshooting inline so users don't have to jump between pages.

sam: Nice! Is this the same panels prototype we tested in the playground?

maggie: Yep, same UX. Dev notes: panels are markdown-rendered, support code snippets, and can be toggled off via the ? icon. We'll ship behind a feature flag per region.

cheng: Can you drop the rollout checklist here? I can take ownership of the metrics/telemetry bits.

maggie: Added below — please skim and claim items. Will open the feature-flag PR and the docs PRs this afternoon.

maggie: Rollout checklist (short):
1. Docs PRs for each affected page (SDK quickstarts, error pages, retries) — add `contextHelp` frontmatter.
2. Feature flag in prod: `docs_context_help_v1` (default off).
3. Instrumentation: event `docs.context_help.view` and `docs.context_help.clicked_example` + user tier tag.
4. Accessibility review (aria roles + keyboard focus).
5. Localization: mark strings for l10n and coordinate with Lina.
6. Canary region: eu-west-1 for 48h, watch CTR and error-reporting.
7. Rollback playbook: disable flag, revert PRs if rendering errors appear.

lina: I can take localization (item 5). What format do we need? JSON bundle or key/value?

maggie: Key/value YAML in the docs repo is best. I'll add the placeholders in the PR.

cheng: I'll take instrumentation. Suggest we include session_id and page_slug in the payload. Also gate telemetry for internal-only builds (no PII).

sam: For the canary, can we surface the new panel CTR on the console per-route dashboard? Ops can help wire that up.

maggie: Yes — Sam, can you ping eng-console and eng-sre? Also need a short runbook for ops in case rendering load spikes (panels are client-rendered but templates preload).

sam: Will do. I'll DM ops and create an entry in the runbook.

docs-bot: Reminder: Maggie scheduled docs PR 2875 for 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC. CI: lint + accessibility checks required.

maggie: Quick note on deprecation — the old floating help widget (help-center-v1) will be deprecated in favor of inline panels. Deprecation timeline: announce today, turn flag off for new accounts in 30 days, full removal in 90 days. We'll add a migration guide.

lina: Got it. I'll block translations for the 30-day announcement copy.

cheng: Logging plan: emit an error if panel fails to hydrate and include stack + page_slug. I'll put rate limits on those errors.

maggie: Thanks everyone. Action items: Cheng (telemetry + error logs), Lina (l10n), Sam (console metrics + ops runbook), Maggie (PRs + feature flag + deprecation notice). I'll follow up with the PR links when they're up. :party_parrot:
